column1: # Per-file byte budgets for loaded agent guidance, checked by scripts/check-guidance-size.sh.
# Format: <repo-relative path><TAB><max bytes>. Blank lines and # comments are allowed.
# Scope: AGENTS.md plus the tracked .claude/rules/*.md files. Every in-scope file needs a row.
# Each budget is the size when the ratchet landed, rounded up to the next 4096-byte multiple.
# Raising a budget is a reviewed edit to this file. The AGENTS.md budget must stay at or
# below 65536, the REPO_INSTRUCTIONS_MAX_BYTES runtime cap in agent/src/repo-instructions.ts.
